title: ECB Governing Council monetary-policy decision + press conference (Frankfurt) — 75 minutes after the Bank of England, and without projections of its own
source: EST: ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the Governing Council monetary-policy meeting calendar lists '3-4 February 2027' in Frankfurt as the first of eight 2027 monetary-policy meetings (03-04 Feb, 17-18 Mar, 28-29 Apr, 09-10 Jun, 21-22 Jul, 08-09 Sep, 27-28 Oct, 15-16 Dec); the decision falls on day two, 4 February, per the ECB's standing two-day convention. The page presents these dates as 'Schedules for the meetings' and marks them neither provisional nor confirmed. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for a non-Fed central bank — the same ground the existing ecb-decision-2026-09-10, ecb-decision-2026-10-29 and ecb-decision-2026-12-17 entries stand on. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of boe-decision-2027-02-04, 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED BY THE boe-decision-2027-02-04 LANE, 2026-09-10. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it is a genuine gap and a same-day collision, not a refinement. This calendar carries ecb-decision entries for 2026-09-10, 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-17 and NOTHING in 2027 — canonically or as anyone's proposal — so the ECB's first 2027 decision is missing outright. It lands on the SAME DAY as the Bank of England's February Monetary Policy Report round and roughly 75 minutes later: the BoE publishes 12:00 London (13:00 CET / 07:00 ET) and the ECB 14:15 CET (08:15 ET), the ECB timing inherited from docs/research/events/ecb-decision-2026-09-10.md, which records 14:15 CET decisions and a 14:45 CET press conference as the Bank's standing convention rather than a date-specific commitment. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROPOSING EVENT, AND THE FINDING IS DIRECTIONAL: ECB staff macroeconomic projections are published 'four times a year (in March, June, September and December)' (ecb.europa.eu/press/projections, fetched direct 2026-09-10), so FEBRUARY IS NOT A PROJECTION ROUND FOR THE ECB. The BoE's 2027-02-04 announcement carries a full Monetary Policy Report; the ECB's, ninety minutes later, does not. That inverts the attribution rule boe-decision-2026-12-17 wrote for this pair — 'check the ECB before crediting the BoE, because the ECB has projections and the BoE has only minutes' — for this specific date, and it is the same inversion boe-decision-2027-04-29 found against the Fed, now against the ECB and on the same day rather than the day before. WHY MEDIUM: matches ecb-decision-2026-09-10, ecb-decision-2026-10-29 and ecb-decision-2026-12-17, all medium, and every BoE and BoJ decision on this calendar. NO SYMBOLS AND NO PLAY: symbols [], this repo tracks no euro-area listing and no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed; the only channel is global term premium and it is second-order. PROMOTION CRITERION: a lane that reads the ECB's own published decision date for 4 February 2027 off a dated ECB surface may write the canonical file; the confirmed prefix still needs a taxonomy slot this calendar does not yet have. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
